description.value: Thai Sechelt serves authentic Thai cuisine in a modern, stylish venue in Sechelt, a laid-back coastal town the restaurant itself describes as 'the land between two waters.' The menu spans curries, noodle soups, stir-fries, and fried rice, with both dine-in and takeout available. Several dishes are marked gluten-free and tofu substitutions appear throughout, making it a welcoming refuelling stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs.
